catalog.title: Gorge Trail surface and wooded edges (2010)
catalog.alt: A granular path curves through woods, with a tree close to the right edge, scattered twigs on the tread and vegetation on both sides.
catalog.caption: This July 2010 Gorge Trail view shows one section of granular surface and its wooded edges. Full frame retained; resized and converted to WebP.
catalog.author: console0
catalog.limitations: Historical view, not a current route inspection. Width, gradient, surface firmness, the complete route and current closures cannot be established. This photograph does not describe the park’s other trails.

catalog.title: Plaza steps, paving and seating (2007)
catalog.alt: An elevated view of Fountain Square shows wide steps with metal handrails in the foreground, paved plaza areas and groups of tables and chairs around the fountain.
catalog.caption: Photographed from the Westin on June 8, 2007, this view shows plaza steps, paving and movable seating, with construction visible beyond the square. Full frame retained; resized and converted to WebP.
catalog.author: MamaGeek
catalog.limitations: Historical overview with small, distant incidental visitors. It does not establish today’s seating layout, an alternative step-free route, garage elevator operation, door controls or stair measurements. The capture date comes from the photographer’s description; June 14 is the original upload date.

catalog.title: Mason sensory guide and attraction photographs
catalog.description: The publisher’s 27-page Mason guide describes sensory conditions and includes attraction photographs on pages 13–20, Grand Lobby and mini-golf views on page 24, arcade views on page 25 and bowling on page 27. Photographs may be representative; capture dates are unknown. This is not a complete access-route walkthrough and does not establish pool-lift operation, transfer assistance, toilet layouts or current conditions.

linkedGuides.policyEvidenceGate: The research helper rejected the 15.4 MB PDF at its 10 MiB limit. No source_checked note was created from this PDF. The original linked guide was independently fetched in full and visually inspected; no images are republished.

officialCAINReview.findings: Pantry shelving and seating, a side-drive view between the two buildings, and a partial side entrance are visible. The alternate Market doorway, the complete step-free route, Annette’s rear ramp and changing equipment are not established. Several images show identifiable guests. No reuse licence was found; no images republished.

findings.finding: Night entrance overview shows front steps and a paved approach; interior views show fixed banquettes, movable chairs and high stools. No continuous alternative entrance, toilet or transfer route is established.

verifiedLicenceExamples.feature: Night entrance, front steps and approach

findings.hold: The current official site confirms 434 Main Street but the reviewed homepage does not supply sufficient access information for a new listing. Capture licence/date per file before any future reuse; other album images are not covered by these two checks.

findings.finding: Early album views show the Latonia Fire Station 8 entrance, paved forecourt and lawn edges; album cover shows a neighborhood corner.
findings.hold: Do not infer a blanket CC0 licence from the photographer. This checked photo is not licensed for reuse. No fire-station visitor-service access listing was created.

additionalStandardViews.disposition: Held for future listing evidence. Further views show front steps, handrails, fixed benches, high stools and some incidental guests; no alternate entrance or toilet route is established.

heldWalkthroughs.status: Official page links a virtual tour, but browser host unavailable. Tour not visually inspected or added to the PDF guide catalog.
heldWalkthroughs.next: Inspect indoor/outdoor ADA areas, garage elevator landing, entrance thresholds and restroom approach with a working browser.

remainingPhotoGaps.sharon-woods: Current Lebanon entrance, parking-to-open toilets, construction detours, open playground/swing locations; old harbor images cannot resolve current routes.
remainingPhotoGaps.fountain-square: Vine Street west-ramp restroom doorway, garage elevator landings and continuous step-free plaza entry; historical overhead view is not a route audit.
remainingPhotoGaps.great-wolf-lodge-mason: Actual Mason pool lifts/zero-depth entries, wheelchair pickup points, accessible suites and adult-changing arrangements; generic guide photos cannot establish these.
remainingPhotoGaps.cain-the-market: Alternate Market doorway and complete route, Annette’s rear ramp, toilet interior/door controls; official people-heavy photos remain linked at source only.
remainingPhotoGaps.megacorp-pavilion: Official tour still needs inspection; garage-to-entrance connection, indoor/outdoor companion arrangements, toilets and quiet spaces.
